commitMessage:
Fix EC2 deploy paths for the arcade rename.

Point the workflow at ~/arcade and the arcade GitHub remote, and migrate any legacy temp-battle checkout on first deploy.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
diffText:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
index 44b4e0e..669ef81 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -32,17 +32,23 @@ jobs:
           username: ${{ secrets.EC2_USER }}
           key: ${{ secrets.EC2_SSH_KEY }}
           port: 22
-          # connection timeout (seconds) — not the same as command_timeout
           timeout: 20s
           command_timeout: 2m
           envs: POSTGRES_USER,POSTGRES_PASSWORD,POSTGRES_DB,DATABASE_URL,SESSION_SECRET,OPENOBSERVE_URL,OPENOBSERVE_USER,OPENOBSERVE_PASSWORD,OPENOBSERVE_LOG_STREAM,OPENOBSERVE_TRACE_STREAM
           script: |
             set -euo pipefail
-            APP_DIR="$HOME/temp-battle"
+            APP_DIR="$HOME/arcade"
             if [ ! -d "$APP_DIR/.git" ]; then
-              git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/fireweave-HQ-Demo/temp-battle.git "$APP_DIR"
+              # migrate from legacy temp-battle checkout if present
+              if [ -d "$HOME/temp-battle/.git" ]; then
+                mv "$HOME/temp-battle" "$APP_DIR"
+                git -C "$APP_DIR" remote set-url origin https://github.com/fireweave-HQ-Demo/arcade.git
+              else
+                git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/fireweave-HQ-Demo/arcade.git "$APP_DIR"
+              fi
             fi
             cd "$APP_DIR"
+            git remote set-url origin https://github.com/fireweave-HQ-Demo/arcade.git
             git fetch --depth=1 origin main
             git reset --hard origin/main
             chmod +x scripts/deploy-prod.sh start.prod stop.prod start stop
diff --git a/scripts/deploy-prod.sh b/scripts/deploy-prod.sh
index 9d6abd1..05311d6 100755
--- a/scripts/deploy-prod.sh
+++ b/scripts/deploy-prod.sh
@@ -41,8 +41,10 @@ OPENOBSERVE_LOG_STREAM=${OPENOBSERVE_LOG_STREAM:-arcade_logs}
 OPENOBSERVE_TRACE_STREAM=${OPENOBSERVE_TRACE_STREAM:-arcade_traces}
 EOF
 
-# Stop legacy dev stack (port 3000) if still running
+# Stop legacy stacks if present
 sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+sudo docker compose -p temp-battle -f docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+sudo docker compose -p temp-battle-prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml down --remove-orphans >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 
 NEED_BUILD=1
 if [[ -n "${PREV_FP}" && "${PREV_FP}" == "${FP}" ]] \
